== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[Karoshan]] Alliance is a relatively small but formidable political and military coalition consisting of the [[Karoshan Empire]], the [[Visiria system]], and several other minor systems. Despite its limited size compared to larger entities like the [[Galactic Union]], it possesses significant power and resources. The Alliance is currently experiencing internal instability due to a civil war between the forces of King Regent{{!}}King Regent Felrex and a rebel faction led by the rightful [[Queen]]. The Alliance's military is characterized by blocky, black vessels, including standard cruisers equipped with starfighters and massive dreadnoughts capable of engaging large portions of an enemy fleet. Their space colonies are often described as moon-sized obsidian cubes. The [[Karoshan people]] and their soldiers have a reputation for being fearsome, sometimes serving as cautionary tales for others. While they are often viewed as enemies by various galactic factions, historical precedents suggest that the Karoshan{{!}}Karoshans and their rivals, such as the [[Lichborn]], have occasionally united to face apocalyptic threats.}}
